in children having elective cardiac surgery, a shortened preanesthetic fasting period (2-3 h) is safe and well tolerated.

the liberalization of the preoperative fasting order for clear liquids was well tolerated in our pediatric cardiac surgical patients.

we have shown that in children undergoing cardiac surgery, a liberalized feeding regimen is safe, well tolerated, and associated with improved parental perception of the patient's comfort, hunger, and thirst.
